# Magic Collection Hair Pick Afro Pick Styling Pik Metal Pik (Pack of 3)

## Lift and Shape Textured Hair

This professional-quality styling pick features a 6.65-inch length and 3-inch width, giving you the reach and coverage to lift roots and shape volume. Use it to fluff curls, define an afro, or add height to your style in a few easy strokes.

## Durable Metal Tines

Built from sturdy metal, each pick feels strong and solid in hand. Smooth metal tines help you work through tangles with less tugging, so detangling and styling feel more comfortable.

## Three Picks for Every Routine

Each set includes three picks, so you can keep one at home, one in your bag, and one in the car. Having a pick within reach makes it easier to refresh your style wherever your day takes you.

## Simple to Clean

Metal tines wipe clean quickly, helping you keep your picks ready for your next style.

## Shop With Confidence

Each set is backed by a satisfaction guarantee. Add the Magic Collection Hair Pick three-pack to your cart today and start styling with tools you can rely on.
